name: @pipeworx/mcp-gamedeals

tools.name: search_deals
tools.description: Search active game deals with optional filters by store, platform, or discount level. Returns deal title, store, sale price, normal price, savings %, Metacritic score, and deal rating.

title.description: Filter deals by game title (partial match supported)

upper_price.description: Maximum price filter (e.g., 5 for deals under $5)

store_id.description: Filter by store ID (use list_stores to get IDs)

page_size.description: Number of results to return (default: 10, max: 60)

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find games by title to compare current prices across stores. Returns cheapest price, deal ID, and availability info for price tracking.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_game_details
tools.description: Get complete pricing history for a game: current deals across all stores, historical low prices, and price trends over time.

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: View all tracked game retailers (e.g., Steam, Epic Games, GOG). Returns store names and IDs for filtering deals by specific stores.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-gamedeals forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the gamedeals pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
